calendar_source: Odisha Govt Gazette & Kohinoor / Radharamana Panji

festivals.name: Makar Sankranti
festivals.significance: Celebration of Uttarayana, Makara Chaula preparation, and grand gathering at Dhabaleswar.

festivals.name: Samba Dashami
festivals.significance: Mothers worship Surya Dev for the health and longevity of their children.

festivals.name: Veer Surendra Sai Jayanti / Netaji Jayanti
festivals.significance: Commemorating the birth anniversary of Odisha's heroic freedom fighter.

festivals.name: Basanta Panchami (Saraswati Puja)
festivals.significance: Worship of the Goddess of learning; ritual commencement of Ratha wood log collection.

festivals.name: Maha Shivaratri (Jagara)
festivals.significance: Night-long fasting culminating in the raising of the Mahadipa at Lingaraj and Puri.

festivals.name: Holi (Dola Melana)
festivals.significance: Festival of colors, regional palanquin processions, and open-air Melana gatherings.

festivals.name: Dola Purnima
festivals.significance: Swinging ritual of Dola Govinda and Radha; ritual reading of the newly published Odia Panji.

festivals.name: Utkal Divas (Odisha Day)
festivals.significance: Commemorating the linguistic formation of Odisha as an independent province in 1936.

festivals.name: Maha Bishuba Sankranti / Pana Sankranti
festivals.significance: Traditional Odia Solar New Year, Basudhara water-pot ritual, and sharing of sweet Bela Pana.

festivals.name: Akshaya Tritiya / Chandan Yatra Begins
festivals.significance: Akhi Muthi Anukula (ceremonial seed-sowing), chariot timber carving initiation, and Narendra Sarovar boat festival.

festivals.name: Savitri Amavasya
festivals.significance: Strict fasting kept by married Odia women praying for the lifespan of their husbands.

festivals.name: Sitalsasthi Yatra
festivals.significance: Celebration of the celestial wedding of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati, primarily in Sambalpur.

festivals.name: Pahili Raja
festivals.significance: Opening day of the 3-day agrarian festival celebrating earth's fertility, swing songs, and Pitha.

festivals.name: Raja Sankranti
festivals.significance: Core day of Raja Parba; all ploughing and agricultural activities halt to rest the soil.

festivals.name: Devasnan Purnima (Snana Yatra)
festivals.significance: Ceremonial 108-pot bathing of the Holy Trinity followed by Hati Besha and Anasara seclusion.

festivals.name: Puri Ratha Yatra (Sri Gundicha)
festivals.significance: Chariot procession of Lord Jagannath, Lord Balabhadra, and Devi Subhadra to Gundicha Temple.

festivals.name: Bahuda Yatra
festivals.significance: The nine-day chariot festival return journey back toward the Singhadwara.

festivals.name: Suna Besha (Bada Tadhau Besha)
festivals.significance: Golden attire darshan of the Holy Trinity on their chariots outside the Srimandir.

festivals.name: Gamha Purnima / Jhulan Purnima
festivals.significance: Balabhadra Janma, livestock decoration, and culmination of swing rituals in Odia mutts.

festivals.name: Ganesh Chaturthi / Nuakhai (Nabanna)
festivals.significance: Ganesh worship across towns; Western Odisha marks Nuakhai by offering the first grains of new crop.

festivals.name: Mahalaya
festivals.significance: Tila Tarpan offerings to forefathers at Bindusagar and Puri Swargadwar; formal invocation of Maa Durga.

festivals.name: Durga Puja (Maha Saptami)
festivals.significance: Opening of decorative Silver Filigree (Chandi Medha) pandals in Cuttack and Bhubaneswar.

festivals.name: Dussehra / Vijaya Dashami
festivals.significance: Aparajita Puja, traditional Astra Puja (weapon worship), and ceremonial Ravan Podi.

festivals.name: Kumar Purnima / Gajalaxmi Puja Begins
festivals.significance: Moon worship (Chandra Puja) by unmarried youth; commencement of Dhenkanal's Lakshmi Puja carnival.

festivals.name: Diwali / Kali Puja / Bada Badua Daka
festivals.significance: Lighting Kaunriya sticks outside homes and in front of Puri Jagannath Temple to call ancestors.

festivals.name: Anla Navami
festivals.significance: Amla tree veneration and sacred 'Radha Pada Darshan' at Sakshigopal Temple.

festivals.name: Kartika Purnima / Boita Bandana & Bali Jatra
festivals.significance: Dawn toy boat floating remembering ancient Sadhabas; opening of the historic Cuttack Bali Jatra.

festivals.name: Prathamastami
festivals.significance: Family ceremony blessing first-born children with new clothes and steamed Enduri Pitha.
